why: KW-47 (docs/KNOWN-WRONG.md) -- /help's argument syntax and vanilla's compact smart-usage form. Jar-verified against brigadier-1.3.10.jar's CommandDispatcher.class constant pool (no javap on this box; read with a small pure-Python classfile parser) and .decomp net/minecraft/server/command/HelpCommand.java: no-arg /help now shows each top-level command's argument shape via getSmartUsage(root, source) instead of D.names()'s bare word, and /help <command> re-parses the WHOLE typed string (narrowing into a sub- path, e.g. /help gamemode survival) and smart-usages the deepest parsed node instead of C.usage()'s one-line-per-runnable-path enumeration off only the first word.
